title: backend/storage/repair-dataset.jsonl (one line)
description: Written by exportTrainingData()/exportDataset.cli.js — one JSON object per line (JSON Lines, not a JSON array). Consumed offline by finetune/train_chanakya.py, not by the running server.

role.description: 'tool' carries a tool's raw result back to the model — general-dataset.jsonl tool-result-interpretation examples only.

tool_call.description: Dot-notation tool action the assistant invoked instead of replying in prose, e.g. 'ApplicationLauncher.open' — general-dataset.jsonl tool-calling examples only.
